english: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
chinese: 我到的时候会议已经开始了。
soundmark: /wen aɪ əˈraɪvd ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæd ɔːlˈredi ˈstɑːrtɪd/

english: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
chinese: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家。
soundmark: /ɪf ɪt reɪnz təˈmɒrəʊ wiː wɪl steɪ æt həʊm/

grammar.label: 条件状语从句
grammar.text: if+一般现在时，主句将来时

english: Although he is young, he knows a lot.
chinese: 虽然他很年轻，但他懂得很多。
soundmark: /ɔːlˈðəʊ hiː ɪz jʌŋ hiː nəʊz ə lɒt/

english: She studies hard so that she can pass CET-4.
chinese: 她努力学习以便能通过四级。
soundmark: /ʃiː ˈstʌdiz hɑːrd səʊ ðæt ʃiː kæn pɑːs siː-iː-tiː fɔːr/

english: He speaks English as if he were a native speaker.
chinese: 他说英语就像母语者一样。
soundmark: /hiː spiːks ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ æz ɪf hiː wɜːr ə ˈneɪtɪv ˈspiːkər/

english: Since you are here, let's start the meeting.
chinese: 既然你在这里，我们开会吧。
soundmark: /sɪns juː ɑːr hɪər lets stɑːrt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

english: You won't succeed unless you work harder.
chinese: 除非你更努力，否则你不会成功。
soundmark: /juː wəʊnt səkˈsiːd ʌnˈles juː wɜːrk ˈhɑːrdər/

english: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
chinese: 无论你去哪里，我都会跟着你。
soundmark: /weərˈevər juː ɡəʊ aɪ wɪl ˈfɒləʊ juː/

english: As time goes by, we all change.
chinese: 随着时间流逝，我们都在改变。
soundmark: /æz taɪm ɡəʊz baɪ wiː ɔːl tʃeɪndʒ/

english: He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately.
chinese: 他太累了，立刻就睡着了。
soundmark: /hiː wɒz səʊ ˈtaɪərd ðæt hiː fel əˈsliːp ɪˈmiːdiətli/

english: Even if I fail, I will try again.
chinese: 即使我失败，我也会再试。
soundmark: /ˈiːvn ɪf aɪ feɪl aɪ wɪl traɪ əˈɡen/

english: In case of emergency, call this number.
chinese: 紧急情况下，打这个电话。
soundmark: /ɪn keɪs əv ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi kɔːl ðɪs ˈnʌmbər/

english: Keep practicing until you get it right.
chinese: 一直练习直到你做对为止。
soundmark: /kiːp ˈpræktɪsɪŋ ʌnˈtɪl juː ɡet ɪt raɪt/

english: Once you understand the rule, it becomes easy.
chinese: 一旦你理解了规则，它就变简单了。
soundmark: /wʌns juː ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə ruːl ɪt bɪˈkʌmz ˈiːzi/

english: No matter how hard it is, we must finish it.
chinese: 无论多难，我们都必须完成。
soundmark: /nəʊ ˈmætər haʊ hɑːrd ɪt ɪz wiː mʌst ˈfɪnɪʃ ɪt/
